description: Compiles ready-to-save /llms.txt documentation index and Google Lighthouse 13.5 /.well-known/ai-catalog.json (ARD 1.0) JSON manifests from a live domain, plus HTML <head> and robots.txt Agentmap snippets. Use this tool when a developer wants to remediate missing discovery manifests identified by audit_ai_readiness. Do not use this tool for general web scraping (use extract_byte0_markdown instead). Read-only synthesis; requires no API key and does not modify remote servers.

domain.description: Target domain name or root URL to generate manifests for (e.g., "example.com" or "https://example.com").

name: generate_ai_manifests
title: Generate /llms.txt & Lighthouse 13.5 ai-catalog.json Manifests
